extra.final_summary: The data had several issues affecting the question: (1) misspelled species labels (Adeile, Chinstarp, Gentto) were corrected to Adelie, Chinstrap, and Gentoo; (2) island labels with trailing spaces (Biscoe , Dream ) were normalized; (3) body_mass_g was stored as text with commas and needed conversion to numbers; (4) three body_mass_g values (4,400,000, 3,400,000, 4,100,000) were far above the allowed max of 6,500 grams and were excluded as likely data entry errors; (5) one flipper_length_mm value (-231) was below the allowed min of 170 mm and was excluded; (6) one exact duplicate row (row 49) was removed. After fixes, the average body mass for males is 4638.2353 grams and for females is 3737.5 grams.
